annotation.title_clean: Opening Remarks Delivered by the Hon. Samuel Nartey George at the National AI Strategy Stakeholder Consultation Forum
annotation.title_en: Opening Remarks Delivered by the Hon. Samuel Nartey George at the National AI Strategy Stakeholder Consultation Forum
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Hon. Samuel Nartey George, Ministry of Communications, Digital Technologies and Innovation (Ghana)
annotation.venue: National AI Strategy Stakeholder Consultation Forum, Ghana
annotation.summary_en: Opening speech by Ghana's communications and digital minister at the April 2025 National AI Strategy stakeholder consultation. It outlines four strategy priorities (data, compute, talent, governance), the One Million Coders Program, and the ambition to make Ghana Africa's AI hub. It contains no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ghana aims to be the AI Hub of Africa
Strategy rests on four priorities: data, compute, talent, governance
Open Data Framework to be developed with the Data Protection Commission
One Million Coders Program embedded in the National AI Strategy
AI should be safe, transparent and purpose driven
